ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray base occupies approximately 75-80% of the visible surface; low-intensity black/dark-gray markings and edges occupy the remaining 20-25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigmentation forms a continuous irregular band along the entire trailing edge; discrete low-intensity circular blobs (mottling) are distributed across the high-intensity medial and lateral fields; highest density of dark pixels concentrated at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 60 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration profile with non-uniform frequency; peaks vary in pixel-amplitude from 5 to 25 pixels; significant jaggedness observed on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep transitioning from the distal tips toward the median notch; the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex outer boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (dark on white) detected; prominent clusters are located on the left distal lobe and distributed sporadically across the right medial lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel vectors; one major diagonal mark (approx. 200 pixels in length) on the right medial lobe; multiple shorter parallel linear marks on both left and right lobes indicative of rake scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks (parallel diagonal tracks) and significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness along the trailing edge boundary; heavy concentration of circular scars from barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips (points) of the fluke lobes exhibit a high-density accumulation of low-intensity pixels and significantly irregular, non-linear edge topography.
